titles.romaji: Norimono Man: Mobile Land no Car-kun
titles.native: のりものまん モービルランドのカークン

description:
The anime depicts various vehicles as characters in the "Mobile Land" island. The protagonist Car-kun arrives at the island as a delivery worker. Through his deliveries, he gets to know the residents of Mobile Land, all while following traffic rules and having his deliveries stopped by the meddling Sabibi.

(Source: Anime News Network)
